_note: v2.4 plan 01 T1 red fixture (no backend). Run: node scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v24-01-cut-range.json --sandbox --group 1759606632088. Four player lines, one boundary each; record_state at the boundary before line 1, then `/cut 1-2`. /cut deletes one message per MESSAGE_DELETED, each after its own splice (host-facts 01-H4), so the two events carry chat lengths 3 then 2. Before the T1 fix the rollbacks start at 3 and 2, and lit_lamp (from a removed line) survives: stateEquals FAILS (red). After the fix each event re-diffs against the snapshot the previous one left and both decode to 1.

steps.eval: const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const greetings = ctx.chat.length; for (let id = ctx.chat.length - 1; id >= 0; id -= 1) await ctx.deleteMessage(id, undefined, false); if (ctx.chat.length !== 0) throw new Error(`the sandbox chat still holds ${ctx.chat.length} message(s) after clearing its greetings, so every message id below would name the wrong line`); return { greetingsCleared: greetings };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; rt.setExtractionSettings({ cadence: 0 }); const state = rt.getEngineState(); if (!state || state.activeCheckpointId !== 'start') throw new Error(`the story did not load at start: ${JSON.stringify(state && state.activeCheckpointId)}`); return { cadence: 0, boundary: state.boundary };

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const lines = SillyTavern.getContext().chat.map((m) => m.mes); const state = rt.getEngineState(); const values = state.blackboard.values; if (lines.length !== 4 || !String(lines[1]).includes('oil lamp') || !String(lines[2]).includes('map')) throw new Error(`the chat is not the four scripted lines, so /cut 1-2 would not remove the lamp and map lines: ${JSON.stringify(lines)}`); if (state.lastMessageId !== 3) throw new Error(`the engine consumed up to message ${state.lastMessageId}, expected 3`); for (const key of ['took_key', 'lit_lamp', 'found_map', 'opened_chest']) if (values[key] !== true) throw new Error(`${key} did not land before the cut: ${JSON.stringify(values)}`); return { values, active: state.activeCheckpointId, boundary: state.boundary };

const lines = SillyTavern.getContext().chat.map((m) => m.mes); if (lines.length !== 2 || !String(lines[1]).includes('iron chest')) throw new Error(`/cut 1-2 did not leave the key and chest lines: ${JSON.stringify(lines)}`); return { lines };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const state = rt.getEngineState(); const fallbacks = rt.getSessionJournal().filter((e) => /message delete/.test(e.summary)).map((e) => e.summary); if (fallbacks.length) throw new Error(`a /cut event was not decoded exactly: ${JSON.stringify(fallbacks)}`); if (state.lastMessageId !== 0) throw new Error(`the engine still claims message ${state.lastMessageId} as consumed; the chest line now at index 1 would never be read again`); return { lastMessageId: state.lastMessageId, values: state.blackboard.values };
